en.name: PilotEnRoute: Pilot Logbook
en.title: PilotEnRoute - Pilot Logbook
en.subtitle: Logbook, currency & go/no-go
en.short_description: Pilot logbook that works out currency and checks weather against your minimums.
en.description:
Before every flight you ask two questions: am I legal for this one, and is today inside my own limits? PilotEnRoute answers both on one card.

Log each flight with the things the regulations count: day and night takeoffs and full-stop landings, approaches, holds, night, instrument and cross-country time. PilotEnRoute works out your passenger currency (day and night), IFR currency, flight review and medical (including BasicMed) from your own entries and dates, and shows the date each one lapses and what you need to fix it.

Set your personal minimums once, for day and for night. Pick your airport and PilotEnRoute pulls the latest METAR and TAF from the Aviation Weather Center. It finds the runway with the least crosswind and shows each number next to your limit.

Search your logbook, see totals for the last 30, 90 and 365 days, and export it as PDF or CSV. Reminders arrive before anything lapses. The Kit has an E6B, weight and balance, fuel and flight planning, representative checklists you can add your own items to, your documents with their expiry dates, airport details and links to FAA terminal procedures.

No account. Your logbook stays on your phone.

PilotEnRoute is a ground planning and record-keeping tool. It is not approved for navigation and does not replace an official weather briefing, your POH/AFM or your instructor. Every go/no-go decision is yours. PilotEnRoute is not affiliated with or endorsed by the FAA, NOAA or any government agency; it reads their public data.

PilotEnRoute is free and shows ads from Google AdMob. Where consent is required you are asked first, and you can change it in Settings > Privacy choices.
en.promotional_text: Log a flight in under a minute. Before the next one, see if you're current for it and whether today's weather is inside your own minimums.
en.release_notes:
First release of PilotEnRoute: a pilot's logbook that works out your currency and checks live METAR/TAF against your own day and night minimums, on one Go Card.

Not approved for navigation. Feedback: contact@americangroup.ai

review_information.notes:
2. DEVICES AND OS VERSIONS TESTED
The unit and widget test suite runs before every build. The app was run end to end through its real UI on an iPhone 17 Pro Max simulator (1320x2868) and an iPad Pro 13-inch simulator (2064x2752), which produced the store screenshots, and on an Android emulator (Pixel 7, API 34).

3. WHAT THIS APP DOES, AND FOR WHOM
PilotEnRoute is a pilot's logbook that works out currency and checks live weather against the pilot's own minimums, for private and student pilots who keep their own records. It is a ground tool, not for use in flight. There is no account and no sign-in; the logbook is stored on the device only.

4. SETTING UP AND REACHING THE MAIN FEATURES
On first launch, choose a home airport (e.g. KPAO), enter your medical details and set your personal minimums for day and night. The Today tab shows the Go Card: legality for the planned flight (passengers / night / IFR), worked out on the device from logged flights, and the latest METAR/TAF from aviationweather.gov compared with your minimums, including crosswind on the best runway. Tap "Log this flight" to add an entry. The Logbook tab has search, totals and PDF/CSV export; Weather shows METAR/TAF for any airport; Kit holds ground tools (E6B, weight and balance, fuel, flight planner, checklists, documents, airport details, links to FAA terminal procedures).

5. EXTERNAL SERVICES USED
- Aviation Weather Center (aviationweather.gov, NOAA): METAR, TAF and airport data. Public API, no account.
- Google AdMob: banner ads in the Logbook list and on the Weather tab. Where consent is required, Google's consent form is shown first; Settings > Privacy choices reopens it.
- Firebase Crashlytics: crash reports.
- FAA and eCFR pages open in the browser from links; the app does not download charts.

6. REGIONAL DIFFERENCES
None. Nothing is remote-configured, hidden or region-dependent.

7. REGULATED INDUSTRY OR THIRD-PARTY MATERIAL
Not a regulated-industry app. Weather and airport data are public US government data (NOAA/FAA); regulation references cite 14 CFR. PilotEnRoute is not affiliated with the FAA, NOAA or any government agency. No licensed third-party content.
